detail.noExe.text: Ntiyashobora kumenyekana binyuze muri porogaramu. Kanda “Vugurura ububikoshingiro” nyuma: igihe Discord izongeramo exe, umukino uzashoboka gukoreshwa.

settings.title: Igenamiterere

settings.autoStop.desc: Decoy yizimya ubwayo igihe cyagenwe kigeze.

settings.legal: Decoy ntikoresha ikimenyetso cyawe cya Discord (token) kandi ntiyakira imikoro mu izina ryawe. Kwigana porogaramu y'umukino bishobora kunyuranya n'amategeko ya Discord, bikoreshe ku ngaruka zawe bwite.
toast.launched: “{name}” itangijwe mu gihe cy'imin {n}. Discord igomba kuyibona mu masegonda nka 15.
toast.timeUp: Igihe cyageze, umukoro wagombye kuba wabazwe
lab.title: Laboratwari

lab.warn: Buri decoy ni porogaramu yihariye ifite idirishya ryayo. Kurenza 200–300 icyarimwe bishobora kugabanya umuvuduko wa mudasobwa yawe, umubare ntarengwa ni {max}.
